title: TagSort profile
description: Describes the identification tags of one collection: what each kind of tag may say. Two rules cannot be expressed in JSON Schema and are checked by TagSort when it loads a profile: tag ids must be unique, and each pattern must follow the regex subset in docs/patterns.md.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the profile follows.

name.description: Human-readable name of the profile, for example the collection it describes.

tags_per_individual.description: Number of tags attached to one specimen.

tags.description: The kinds of tag found in this collection.

id.description: Identifier of this kind of tag, reported as tag_id in results. Unique within the profile.

pattern.description: Every text this kind of tag may carry, in the regex subset of docs/patterns.md. Always matched against the whole text.
